messages:
Mike R.: kicking a config-only change to routing/batching/timeouts now. small canary (3%) for 15m. changes: per-tenant concurrency 12 -> 8, default request timeout 18s -> 12s, batching window 8ms -> 5ms. change-id cfg-20260321-17. goal: reduce token cost tail. deploybot will start canary.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary started for cfg-20260321-17 on redwood/serving-configs. Targets: canary pool (3 hosts), percent=3%. Monitors: latency, error_rate, kvcache_pressure. canary link: https://dash/redeploy/CFG-20260321-17
Sophia L.: noted. I'll watch p95/p99 + kvcache hit rate. adding a quick query to the dashboard now.
Jordan (ML Eng): heads up — shorter timeouts can cause more aborts on long-chained prompts (llm-long tenant). watch p99 and aborted requests for that tenant specifically.
Carl P.: pinning routing for canary to model-variant stable-1 to avoid model drift during the test.
ops-oncall: oncall here. I'll keep pages enabled: alert if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 increases > 10% baseline. drain window keep=10m.
deploy-bot: canary at 3% after 5m: metrics snapshot -> error_rate 0.06%, p95 +2%, kvcache miss rate unchanged. no immediate infra alarms. :white_check_mark:
Sophia L.: quick thought — routing policy for bursty tenants is currently broad. If we tighten for burst-tenants group we might avoid the tail. propose add tenant-level routing override for the next stage.
Mike R.: sounds reasonable. i'd like to expand to stage=12% for 10m to get stronger signal unless objections.
Jordan (ML Eng): i'm seeing p99 drift for llm-long: +12% vs baseline correlated with requests hitting batching window change. not massive but trending. i recommend hold and reduce concurrency for that tenant or rollback.
Carl P.: agree with Jordan. we should soft-pin llm-long to stable-1 and lower concurrency to 6 for that tenant before expanding. otherwise rollback.
Mike R.: consensus leans rollback given p99 increase. decision: rollback config-only change for cfg-20260321-17. follow-up ticket for per-tenant gating. @deploy-bot please initiate rollback.
deploy-bot: :leftwards_arrow_with_hook: Rollback initiated for cfg-20260321-17. Reverting to previous config across canary. ETA ~2m. Notifying oncall.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary reverted and change marked rolled-back. Post-rollback metrics: p99 back to baseline for affected tenants. reason: increased tail latency (p99) for llm-long correlated with batching window/concurrency change.
Mike R.: thanks. Draft release-note snippet: "CONFIG-20260321-17: attempted config-only change (timeouts/batching/concurrency) to reduce token costs; rolled back after detecting increased p99 for long-inference tenant. Next: implement per-tenant concurrency gating + staged A/B for batching window. See FR-1234." Feel free to edit.
Sophia L.: i'll add dashboard panels and create a short alert to flag this specific pattern. assigning to Jordan for RCA.
Jordan (ML Eng): i'll own RCA. will look into kv-cache interaction and whether the shorter batching window is reducing effective prefix-sharing. will report back within EOD.
ops-oncall: marking this incident as closed for now. we'll re-run after Jordan's fixes and a stricter gating plan. add to next change window (weekend low-traffic slot).
Mike R.: good catch team. follow-up tickets: FR-1234 (per-tenant gating), OBS-987 (dashboard + alerts). i'll schedule a preflight for the next attempt. :thumbsup:
